summary: Iteration 5 targeted regression on projection + local hero image changes. Backend: /api/outstanding and /api/dashboard/stats pass all shape/non-zero checks. /api/analytics/inventory has a REGRESSION — projection dropped the 'cost' field so total_cost is always 0 (verified via API and visible on UI as 'COST VALUE ₹0'). Frontend: hero image at /login-hero.jpg loads successfully (naturalWidth=1400, same-origin). Login flow, Outstanding page (3 tables + 4 aging buckets), and Inventory Analytics page all render. Dashboard renders charts (36 SVGs, 106 recharts elements).

critical.issue: Regression from projection optimization: proj dict at server.py line ~410 omits 'cost' field, so 'cost' is never loaded from Mongo, causing total_cost to always be 0. This also breaks the 'COST VALUE' KPI card on the Inventory Analytics screen (visibly displays ₹0). Fix: add "cost": 1 to the projection dict.

ui_bugs.issue: Displays ₹0 because backend total_cost is 0 (root cause: server-side projection drops 'cost'). Fix on backend.

action_items: In /app/backend/server.py inventory_analytics (~line 410), add 'cost': 1 to the projection dict so total_cost is computed correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py inventory_analytics projection missed 'cost' — silent regression because response key still present but always 0. Consider adding a smoke test that asserts total_cost > 0 to catch such projection drift.
outstanding_report and dashboard_stats projections look correct — all fields used downstream are included.
Login.jsx: using an empty alt='' on a decorative hero image is fine, but the div is aria-hidden by nature; OK.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (visual/UX all good; only the cost-related KPI shows 0 due to backend regression)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 5 regression test lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_regression.py. Only /api/analytics/inventory total_cost is failing. Once main agent adds 'cost': 1 to the projection in server.py inventory_analytics, re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_regression.py -v. Hero image regression fully passes (src=/login-hero.jpg, naturalWidth=1400).
rca_of_the_issue: In /app/backend/server.py::inventory_analytics, the MongoDB projection dict `proj` (line ~410) enumerates fields to fetch. It includes 'mrp' and 'qty' but omits 'cost'. Later the code sums `(it.get('cost') or 0) * (it.get('qty') or 0)` for total_cost, which always evaluates to 0 because 'cost' is never present on the returned documents. Mitigation: add `"cost": 1` to `proj`. Reproduction: GET /api/analytics/inventory with admin token → total_cost==0 while total_mrp is large. Also visible on UI: Inventory Analytics 'Cost Value' KPI shows ₹0.
